name: Strade Bianche
story: After 40 km of racing, the first meaningful breakaway formed. UAE Team Emirates controlled the peloton and stretched it on Monte Sante Marie, where everything came together and Tadej Pogačar subsequently attacked; Paul Seixas followed the longest but was dropped. Pogačar won after a 79 km solo, while Seixas dropped Isaac del Toro on the final steep kilometre to secure second.
